Summary: Idempotency, optimistic concurrency and transactional outbox foundation
Description: As an engineer, I want shared idempotency, concurrency and outbox mechanics, so that retries, duplicate callbacks and out-of-order events never corrupt admissions data.
Acceptance Criteria:
1) Idempotency-Key supported on create, submit, accept, payment-intent and handover calls; same key with a different payload returns 409.
2) Version/ETag checks available to every mutating endpoint.
3) Events are written in the same transaction as the state change and published only after commit using the platform outbox if one exists; Kafka is not assumed (D-10).
4) Standard event envelope: eventId, tenantId, applicationId, occurredAt, correlationId, schema version; payloads exclude PII, payment data and reviewer comments.
5) Consumers are documented as duplicate- and out-of-order-tolerant.

Acceptance Criteria:
1) Expiry uses the configured timezone and validity rules.

4) OfferExpired is emitted; notification and seat-release events follow after commit.
